concept: The only copy of a website as one black 3.5-inch floppy disk on a bone table, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side three ways. Low and whole: its label says Website. Right up against the label: the DATE line is empty. From above, later: DATE filled in and a red tick, because a backup you've put back is the one that counts. Bone, black plastic, brushed steel and one red.
